mapper.select: SELECT id, title, priority, due_kind, due_date, due_time, is_completed, memo FROM todo_tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, title, priority, due_kind, due_date, due_time, is_completed, memo FROM todo_tasks WHERE (user_id = #{userId}) AND (priority = #{priority})
SELECT id, title, priority, due_kind, due_date, due_time, is_completed, memo FROM todo_tasks WHERE (user_id = #{userId}) AND ((due_date >= #{startDate}) AND (due_date < #{endDate}))
SELECT id, title, priority, due_kind, due_date, due_time, is_completed, memo FROM todo_tasks WHERE (user_id = #{userId}) AND (is_completed = False)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_tasks (user_id, title, priority, due_kind, due_date, due_time, is_completed, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{priority}, #{dueKind}, #{dueDate}, #{dueTime}, #{isCompleted}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE todo_tasks SET title=#{title}, priority=#{priority}, due_kind=#{dueKind}, due_date=#{dueDate}, due_time=#{dueTime}, is_completed=#{isCompleted}, memo=#{memo} WHERE id = #{id}
